Debounce.Debounce class:
import time

class Button:
    def __init__(self, pin, debounce_s=0.05):
        import digitalio
        self._btn = digitalio.DigitalInOut(pin)
        self._btn.direction = digitalio.Direction.INPUT
        self._btn.pull = digitalio.Pull.UP
        self._debounce_s = debounce_s
        self._last_state = True
        self._last_change = 0

    def pressed(self):
        reading = self._btn.value
        now = time.monotonic()
        if reading != self._last_state and (now - self._last_change) > self._debounce_s:
            self._last_change = now
            prev = self._last_state
            self._last_state = reading
            return prev and not reading  # True on falling edge
        return False

DSP Filters.Integer EMA (no float):
# alpha_q8: 0-256 (26 = heavy, 128 = light)
ALPHA_Q8 = 26
ema_q8 = None

def ema_int(raw):
    global ema_q8
    if ema_q8 is None:
        ema_q8 = raw << 8
    ema_q8 = (ALPHA_Q8 * (raw << 8) + (256 - ALPHA_Q8) * ema_q8) >> 8
    return ema_q8 >> 8

Sensor Patterns.NTC thermistor (beta method):
import math

B = 3950
T0 = 298.15  # 25 C in Kelvin
R0 = 10000   # 10K NTC
R_PULL = 10000

raw = adc.value
if raw == 0 or raw == 65535:
    temp_c = None
else:
    r_ntc = R_PULL * raw / (65535 - raw)
    temp_k = 1.0 / (math.log(r_ntc / R0) / B + 1.0 / T0)
    temp_c = temp_k - 273.15
Sensor Patterns.Sensor lookup table:
LUT = [
    (0,     -400),  # raw, value*10 (tenths of deg C)
    (8000,  -100),
    (16000,  100),
    (32000,  250),
    (48000,  450),
    (65535,  800),
]

def lut_interp(raw):
    if raw <= LUT[0][0]:
        return LUT[0][1]
    for i in range(1, len(LUT)):
        if raw <= LUT[i][0]:
            dy = LUT[i][1] - LUT[i-1][1]
            dx = LUT[i][0] - LUT[i-1][0]
            return LUT[i-1][1] + dy * (raw - LUT[i-1][0]) // dx
    return LUT[-1][1]
